newsitem.title: USA: Dover sees Q4 results exceeding prior year.
newsitem.headline: Dover sees Q4 results exceeding prior year.

text.p: Dover Corp said on Friday that it expects its overall results in the fourth quarter to "comfortably" exceed the $0.60 per share reported for the fourth quarter of last year.
The company said full year results, excluding a third quarter gain on divestitures, are expected to set a record with an increase in earnings per share of about 20 percent.
Dover said it does not expect its elevator unit to match its third quarter result in the fourth quarter, but will probably at least equal the $18.5 million operating result of last year.
Dover said profit levels at its Diversified unit in the fourth quarter are expected at about third-quarter levels.
Dover said its Imaje unit improved sales in the U.S. and Asia, offsetting weakness in Europe and further improved its margins.
Dover said orders for its Universal unit are expected to improve in the fourth quarter, but no major recovery in this market is expected until late 1997.
